question:
Select the figure that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a66bc44db2743d454daade51a57c62654d6dacd3faac81baa569b9a3a6c74345.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) The whole element is rotated 45º anticlockwise.

2) One line is added in each figure subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82c4b42023f60bb241e07f49d4ff208988210883f9453bc6075673ef917f07c2.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d03a1adbd36dd063a5361aa7d43c8d6d242ea2fa56b985f3afed08b5bcd4391.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
